children: H.B. Fuller launched Kōfinity, a product portfolio built on its 4SG technology, rebranded as fusion bonded spacers for insulating glass, aiming to improve window seal reliability and thermal performance.
Signals new product cycle that could support growth in building materials end markets.
Leverages a field-proven base, reducing adoption risk for customers.
Claims tighter seals and thermal gains, a selling point amid energy-efficiency demand.
Large installed base supports credibility and potential cross-sell.
Reliability claim may drive specification by architects and OEMs.

This is an early-stage product platform move extending a proven technology into a refreshed category. A catalyst would require evidence of orders, OEM adoptions, or revenue contribution tied to Kōfinity in upcoming quarters.
